metrics.name: Lines of Code
metrics.description: The number of lines of code including comments.

metrics.name: Lines of JSX Code
metrics.description: The line count of root level JSX elements.

metrics.name: Maximum JSX nesting
metrics.description: JSX nesting is counted by the number of nested JSX children or JSX elements in JSX expressions starting with 1 for the top level.

metrics.name: Cyclomatic Complexity
metrics.description: The number of distinct paths through a block of code.

metrics.name: Halstead Difficulty
metrics.description: The difficulty to write or understand the program, e.g. when doing code review.

metrics.name: Halstead Bugs
metrics.description: An estimate for the number of errors in the implementation.

metrics.name: Parameter Count
metrics.description: The number of parameters, analysed statically from the function signature. (ignoring the arguments object)

icons.description: This component exceeds at least one metric threshold. A solution might be to split it into smaller components.
